description: Per-event ledger. Populate within 48h of every event. After 5 events, patterns emerge that no single retro can show.

events.event_name: Casper Agentic Buildathon 2026 (DoraHacks; qualification + final round)

simulated_panel_score.note: S13 judge loop ran at qualification against mock mode; no panel on the real-mode final submission. Deadline-day field read (2026-07-26) from 5 card screenshots said 'likely top-3' and called the payment-rail, trust-layer and RWA clusters 'the 80% trap' (evidence level 0-1).

events.actual_placement: Final round: not placed. 10 of 116 finalists placed (1st Faktura; 2nd CSPR402, CasCet, Claros; 3rd ATLAS, AgentEscrow402, Casper Trust Layer, Sluice, Lastre, ARIA). Known by 2026-09-16.
lessons_into_skill: Judged path must be real mode, not demo fallback
Liveness health: outcomes within windows, not key presence
Form recon on day 1 (960-char card limit, AI tag)
No redesign in last 24h
Judging-window ops: treasury at 0 through judging
Brief emphasis ('particular emphasis on DeFi and/or RWA') and an outside user are part of brief fit (Operating Rule 15, I16)
Organiser guidance becomes the next work block the day it arrives (Operating Rule 19, I17)
Clusters the brief names are demand, not traps; read the field before ranking (Operating Rule 20, I18, arsenal/field)
Freeze main from deadline to results; watchdog armed before submitting (Operating Rule 12, G15, I19)
The judge's first click: a real proof with no wallet and no funds (golden-path section 8)
On-chain claims checked against signer/caller on the explorer (claims-and-evidence rule 8)

how_to_add_event.step_1: Copy the last event object. Reset id, date, project, scores.
how_to_add_event.step_2: At G6/G8 record simulated_panel_score (label SELF-SCORE unless blind) and screen_rank from screening-judge.md. This is the pre-commit forecast. Set verified: true only when a transcript or retro backs the entry.
how_to_add_event.step_3: Fill actual_placement + prize within 48h of results.
how_to_add_event.step_5: Add 1-3 lessons_into_skill that actually update SKILL.md / arsenal / templates.

calibration_rule: Every entry must be backed by a transcript or a retro. Three fabricated entries (ETHGlobal Bangkok 2025 / Aegis, X Layer Arena 2026 / Bench v1, Stellar Agentic 2026 / TollPay v1) were deleted on 2026-09-14 on Raj's confirmation that they never happened. simulated_panel_score from the building session is a SELF-SCORE and never a placement forecast; record blind screen rank separately (screen_rank).

calibration_log.blind_screen: median rank 3 of 10, advanced 3 of 3 (post-hoc, text only); first place ranked #1 in 3 of 3; real winners filled 6 of 9 top-3 slots
calibration_log.reading: A top-3 text screen is necessary, not sufficient: the jury also weighed the video, the live app and real-world fit. The screener's per-entry answers ('partly' fit, no outside user) matched the pre-mortem.
